description: The file defines the 'Adaptable' interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package, which provides methods for creating, accessing, and inspecting the topic path, payload, and headers of adaptable objects within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context.

classes.name: Adaptable
classes.description: An interface representing objects that can be mapped to and from Ditto commands, responses, or events, providing methods for accessing their topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for creating immutable Adaptable instances for a given topic path.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the topic path associated with this Adaptable instance.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload of this Adaptable instance.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the optional DittoHeaders if present; deprecated in favor of getDittoHeaders().

methods.name: containsHeaderForKey
methods.description: Checks if the Adaptable contains a header with the specified key.
